item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows Gopal completing a mirror image across a fixed horizontal symmetry line. Point $B$ is $4\,\mathrm{cm}$ above the line, at a marked horizontal position.

Where does the reflected point $B'$ belong?

options.A: $B'$ is $4\,\mathrm{cm}$ below the line, at the same horizontal position as $B$.
options.B: $B'$ is the name mirror image for the symmetry line itself.
options.C: $B'$ may sit anywhere below the line, at any distance.
options.D: First place $B'$, and that placement is what creates the symmetry line.
